context_for_next_testing_agent: Anamnese form P0 bug is FIXED. The issue was SelectContent missing position='popper' which caused the form to navigate away when selecting dropdown options. All 12 Select components in AnamneseFormComplete.js now have this property. Additionally, a missing helper function cleanAnamnesisPayload was added to supabase.js to fix anamnesis creation. The form now correctly: (1) opens dropdowns without navigating away, (2) shows 'Alterações não salvas' indicator, (3) saves to database, (4) persists data between section switches.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: SelectContent components in Radix UI/shadcn-ui need position='popper' to prevent focus issues that cause parent containers to lose focus and trigger navigation. Secondary bug: supabase.js createAnamnesis function called cleanAnamnesisPayload which was never defined, causing ReferenceError on new anamnesis creation.
